name: Vitalwinch
description: Pair every post of the great catapult crew with a mirror post so a fallen hand is answered at once.

name: Skein Premonition
description: Load two matched stones into the great cup side by side so the arm throws them as a pair.

name: Releasepin Vigil
description: Beat the count of the draw on a drum so both court columns hear the same beat.

name: Stoneload Vitality
description: Spread one field of qi over both winding crews so their draws rise together.

name: Buoying Winchdrum
description: Send qi into both skeins and listen for the single note they sound when matched.

name: Facet Basecradle
description: Free the arm on the second drumbeat so the throw leaves in step with the twin frame beside it.

name: Facet Torsion
description: Throw from two frames on crossing lines so both stones reach the mark in the same breath.

name: Skeinscourge
description: Link the casts of the court's frames so their stones fall in an interlocking pattern across a broad field.

name: Devastating Rumble Stonefall
description: Bring both great arms to full draw and loose them on one count so their stones strike one point as a single blow.

name: Winchvigil
description: Tend the pitch cauldron on a steady low fire so the pitch stays thin enough to pour and never boils over.

name: Verity Armcup
description: Choose river clay jars of even wall by the sound they give when tapped with a knuckle.

name: Waning Throwarm
description: Watch the burning ground from the hawk post and call where the pitch has pooled.

name: Charter Axlepin
description: Douse the frame and cup with river water between throws so a splash of pitch cannot catch.

name: Ferocious Bombardment
description: Loft a pitch jar with qi under it so it keeps its seal until it breaks on the target.

name: Mangling Frameside
description: Fan the spread of a lit jar with a gust of qi so the flame runs across a basin floor.

name: Unrelenting Frameside
description: Hold a ward of qi over a wet cloth screen so the crew stands safe from the heat.

name: Arcflight Wrath
description: Cast a run of pitch jars along a riverbank so a curtain of flame closes the shore.

name: Weighty Arcflight
description: Track a target with the eye and send a pitch jar down so it bursts inside the breach it finds.

name: Siltunwind
description: Loose a massed cast of pitch jars in one great arc that sets a whole river crossing alight.

name: Skeinrespite
description: Bed two engines on the basin floor a measured distance apart on shared sleeper beams.

name: Skeininsight
description: Keep a shared tally of the range of both engines so one correction serves the pair.

name: Elevating Basecradle
description: Lock the wheels of both engines with matching wedges before either arm is drawn.

name: Beneficent Throwarm
description: Weave qi between two crews so both engines wind to the same tooth at the same moment.

name: Glint Ballistic
description: Time a second stone to leave just as the first lands so the blows follow like an echo.

name: Waning Axlepin
description: Read both impacts at once and correct each engine by the distance the other missed.

name: Shadewinch
description: Keep a steady alternate fire from both engines so the target ground is never clear to cross.

name: Tempered Unwind
description: Drive stones from both engines onto one breach so they strike close and open it wide.

name: Merciless Skein Reckoning
description: Loose both engines in a single cast so their stones fall in a hammering line that cracks the ground.

name: Winchinsight
description: Lay two parallel rails under the wheels of the engine so it can be shifted between two firing tracks.

name: Torrent Winchdrum
description: Haul the engine across from one rail to the other by its side ropes without re-bedding.

name: Intent Armcup
description: Mark one skein with blue thread and the other with white so the crew keeps the pair matched.

name: Hoarfrost Stoneload
description: Set stop pegs at the rail ends so recoil never carries the engine off its track.

name: Chimeskein
description: Hold a cord for the bearing of each track and pick the one the target has not answered.

name: Gust Ballistic
description: Throw from one rail then slide to the other and throw again so the enemy's answer lands on empty ground.

name: Winchrespite
description: Pass qi from the tired skein to the fresh one so the throw of the arm never sags.

name: Unseen Bombardment
description: Root qi through the wheels and rail and heave the loaded engine across in a single pull.

name: Ferocious Unwind
description: Fire from the first track to draw the enemy's reply then use its fall to aim the second throw.

name: Slag Releasepin
description: Alternate casts between the two tracks so the fall of stones seems to come from two engines.

name: Nova Stoneload
description: Draw from the first track and loose from the second in one motion so the stone arrives where it is least expected.

name: Winchglimmer
description: Float a disassembled frame across a river on paired rafts lashed side by side.

name: Vital Skein
description: Lay sleeper beams on the far bank so the rebuilt frame stands on a firm bed.

name: Skeinvigil
description: Call the order of the train so frames and stones and skein bundles cross in matched pairs.

name: Granite Stonefall
description: Lay planks over mud so the heavy wheels do not sink as the engine is brought to the bank.

name: Unassailable Armcup
description: Steady a raft-mounted frame with qi so it can throw once without capsizing.

name: Might Torque
description: Lift a frame off a raft and up a muddy bank with qi through the whole crew.

name: Winchdrum Reckoning
description: Throw stones at the far bank to keep the enemy's heads down while the crossing goes on.

name: Armcupruin
description: Throw heavy stones into the works raised at the water's edge to open a landing.

name: Granite Frameside
description: Keep a measured rain of stones on the far landing so that no boat can put in.

name: Blistering Arcflight
description: Cast every engine of the train in turn on the far shore so the landing is cleared before the boats touch.

name: Healing Axlepin
description: Read the height of the cloud ceiling so a high lob is not lost in the mist.

name: Might Torsion
description: Hoist a heavy stone with a tripod and sling to the cup rim in one smooth haul.

name: Buoying Throwarm
description: Chalk the falling line on a marking board so the crew can see where the stone should come down.

name: Winchruin
description: Send a stone up in a climbing line that hangs and then falls on a marked point.

name: Chime Releasepin
description: Call the fall from a second post so the crew at the frame hears two eyes agree.

name: Prescient Torsion
description: Lay qi along the stone so it drops heavier at the end of its fall.

name: Grievous Basecradle
description: Loft a stone higher than the enemy expects so it stoops from the sky and breaks a roof.

name: Mayhem Ballistic
description: Cast a flock of stones so they fall one after another along the chalked field of the court.

name: Berserk Unwind
description: Throw a stone so high that its fall carries the whole weight of the draw into one blow.

name: Intent Frameside
description: Anchor the bed with long iron pins driven into the plateau so the frame holds through the far throw.

name: Intent Basecradle
description: Haul the wind rope that holds the nose of the frame to its bearing as the arm is drawn.

name: Beneficent Axlepin
description: Weigh each far-throw stone against the oath weight so the crew knows the shot is true.

name: Armcupvigil
description: Mark the plateau lip and the wind side so the crew knows where a long shot will fall.

name: Nova Stonefall
description: Throw with the wind on the back and lengthen the rise of the arm so the stone rides far.

name: Titanic Winchdrum
description: Lay qi along the skeins on the sworn count so the arm reaches farther than its bed suggests.

name: Armcupinsight
description: Hold the draw through a dying gust and release in the first breath of the next.

name: Hollowarmcup
description: Loose a stone along the bearing so that it crosses the whole plateau and breaks the line at its end.

name: Vengeful Torque
description: Cast stones in a long falling line along the bearing so the far ground is swept.

name: Torquehavoc
description: Give the throw every oath of the crew and all the qi of the draw so the stone reaches the far field.

name: Vital Stoneload
description: Stand each crew hand at its sworn post and call the post aloud before any draw.

name: Verityskein
description: Inspect the arm along its length for splits that the wind has opened in the dry grain.

name: Clear Throwarm
description: Choose stones from the plateau scree and cull any that are flaked by the frost.

name: Mightwinch
description: Wind the arm to the sworn count with qi on every turn so that none shirks.

name: Ferocious Ballistic
description: Draw wind and qi into the arm so it whips through the throw faster.

name: Silt Stonefall
description: Pack plateau scree in the cup and burst it high so it falls as a hard grey rain.

name: Blistering Releasepin
description: Fix the bearing by oath and loose a stone that drives straight through the shields of a closed rank.

name: Downpour Unwind
description: Cast a hail of stones into a massed rank so it must break and open its line.

name: Torque Devastation
description: Swear the crew to the last tooth and cast a stone that falls with the whole oath of the crew behind it.

name: Buoying Skein
description: Raise the frame under open sky on a bearing post so wind reaches the arm from every side.

name: Remnant Armcup
description: Chalk the bearing on a post at the rear of the frame and sight over it with one eye.

name: Sharp Torsion
description: Count the speed of passing clouds and add it to the bearing for a long throw.

name: Galvanizing Winchdrum
description: Wind the crank from a wide stance with the back foot braced against a stake.

name: Rumblearmcup
description: Lock the aim on the bearing post and loose so the stone follows it despite a gust.

name: Releasepin Premonition
description: Send qi into the wind around the stone and learn how it will move it before release.

name: Obdurate Armcup
description: Turn a gust that would shove the frame aside with a sweep of qi across its flank.

name: Grievous Bombardment
description: Loose a stone on a straight sky line so it lances into a distant column without arcing.

name: Silt Frameside
description: Cast a spread of stones that the wind pulls into a wide arc along the held bearing.

name: Facet Bombardment
description: Hold the bearing through the whole draw and loose a stone that lands exactly where the oath marked.

name: Illuminating Torsion
description: Bind several heavy stones in a net so they ride the cup together in a storm.

name: Revitalizing Basecradle
description: Watch the storm front cross the plateau and count the beats between flash and sound.

name: Aegis Throwarm
description: Sand the loading floor so wet boots do not slip when the stone is lifted.

name: Merciless Stoneload
description: Loose a netted bundle of stones so the net tears open over the target.

name: Skein Vitality
description: Wind the crank on the rolling beat of the storm so qi and thunder keep one pace.

name: Winchdurance
description: Hold a ward of qi over the skeins against the rain that would slacken their twist.

name: Unwindhavoc
description: Throw netted stones into the storm wind so they fall as a storm of their own on the field.

name: Novawinch
description: Loose a single great stone with a crack of qi so it strikes with a sound like thunder.

name: Winchhavoc
description: Keep a pounding fall of stones on a position through a long storm so no force can hold it.

name: Verity Stoneload
description: Mark the wind road with a line of flags running from the frame to the far ridge.

name: Unerring Torsion
description: Wave a cloth from a ridge post to tell the crew where the last stone fell.

name: Might Axlepin
description: Tension the long guy rope that steadies the arm tip against the crosswind.

name: Verity Axlepin
description: Pick light dense stones that carry far on the wind road and weigh them against a standard.

name: Might Bombardment
description: Haul the frame along the plateau road by its trail ropes to take up a new bearing.

name: Facet Unwind
description: Loose a stone along the flag line so it follows the road to the ridge.

name: Stonefall Wrath
description: Lay qi along the flag line so the stone rides it like a rail across the wind.

name: Waningskein
description: Read the ridge signal and correct the next draw by the width of the miss.

name: Devastating Torque
description: Loose a stone along the whole wind road so that it shatters the field works at its end.

name: Arcflight Ruin
description: Cast stones in a long falling train along the wind road so the far ridge is covered.

name: Winchdrum Devastation
description: Draw the arm to its last oath tooth and loose a stone that crosses the whole road and lands on one flag.

name: Intent Releasepin
description: Ring the camp with engines set far apart so none stands in another's blind spot.

name: Resurgent Basecradle
description: Post a sentry on the wind side to hear a charge before it reaches the frames.

name: Intentwinch
description: Bind the frame for the march in a fixed order so it can be struck in a short while.

name: Chime Arcflight
description: Swing the frame on its wheels to meet a rush from the open side and loose before it closes.

name: Thorn Skein
description: Hold a ring of qi around the crew of the engine so a rush on the open camp finds no soft side.

name: Torqueruin
description: Loose a spread of small stones low across the ground to break the front of a charge.

name: Punishing Throwarm
description: Cast a heavy hail into the path of a charge so its ranks are broken before they close.

name: Gustunwind
description: Answer the first stone of the enemy engine at once and throw back along its own line.

name: Mangling Arcflight Reckoning
description: Ring the camp in a single cast of every engine so the whole open front takes the sworn hail at once.
